title: NABTEB NBC/NTC
issuer: National Business and Technical Examinations Board
content_provenance: Original practice items authored from the public NABTEB NBC/NTC syllabus. Not a capture of past exam questions.

items.stem: Adebayo reached the motor park two hours before departure because he feared missing the only bus to the city, and he still grew anxious when the driver arrived late. Why did Adebayo arrive so early?
options: To avoid missing the only bus
To help the driver load luggage
items.explanation: The passage states that he feared missing the only bus to the city, so his early arrival was to make sure he did not miss it.

items.stem: The old trader told his apprentice that a customer treated rudely may never return, while one welcomed warmly will bring his friends along. What lesson is the trader teaching?
options: Customers should be charged high prices
Courtesy in business attracts more customers
items.explanation: The contrast between rudeness that drives a customer away and warmth that brings friends shows that courtesy attracts business.

items.stem: When the rain started, the market women quickly covered their goods and waited calmly under the shed until it stopped before reopening their stalls. What does their action show?
options: They had no goods to sell
They wanted to leave the market
They were careless with their goods
items.explanation: Covering their goods promptly and waiting calmly until the rain stopped shows that the women were careful and patient.

items.stem: Ngozi read the notice twice before signing and asked the clerk to explain the parts she did not understand before she appended her signature. What quality did Ngozi display?
items.explanation: Reading twice and seeking clarification before signing shows a cautious person who avoids mistakes by checking details.

items.stem: The chairman described the new apprentice as a rough diamond who only needed polishing, meaning that the apprentice had good ability that required training. What did the chairman mean?
options: The apprentice had potential that needed development
The apprentice had no useful ability
items.explanation: A rough diamond is valuable but unpolished, so the chairman meant the apprentice had good natural ability that needed training.

items.stem: Choose the word that is nearest in meaning to diligent as used in the sentence, The diligent student finished her assignment long before the deadline.
items.explanation: Diligent means showing steady and careful effort, so hardworking is the nearest synonym; lazy is its opposite.

items.stem: Choose the word that is most nearly opposite in meaning to expand as used in the sentence, The company plans to expand its business next year.
items.explanation: To expand is to grow larger, so its opposite is shrink; grow, extend and enlarge are all close in meaning to expand.

items.stem: Choose the word that is nearest in meaning to courteous as used in the sentence, The receptionist gave a courteous reply to every visitor.
items.explanation: Courteous means polite and respectful in manner, so polite is the nearest synonym, while rude is its opposite.

items.stem: Fill the gap. The manager together with his assistants ____ expected at the meeting this afternoon.
items.explanation: The subject is the singular manager; the phrase together with his assistants does not change it, so the singular verb is is correct.

items.stem: Fill the gap. Neither the clerk nor the typists ____ willing to work late on Friday evening.
items.explanation: With neither and nor the verb agrees with the nearer subject typists, which is plural, so the correct form is were.

items.stem: Fill the gap. It is high time the apprentice ____ his tools properly before leaving the workshop.
items.explanation: The expression it is high time is followed by the past tense even though the meaning is present, so the correct form is kept.

items.stem: When the supervisor told the workers that they should pull their weight, he meant that every worker should
options: do a fair share of the work
items.explanation: To pull one's weight is an idiom meaning to do one's fair share of the work, not a literal act of lifting or losing weight.

items.stem: The proverb make hay while the sun shines advises a trader to
options: act promptly when the opportunity is good
rest during the hottest part of the day
work only at noon each day
items.explanation: The proverb means one should take advantage of a good opportunity while it lasts, so the trader should act promptly when conditions favour him.

items.stem: Which of the following words has its primary stress on the second syllable?
items.explanation: Begin is stressed on the second syllable, beGIN, while market, table and father are all stressed on the first syllable.

items.stem: Which of the following words contains a vowel sound different from the others?
items.explanation: Sit, hit and bit contain the short vowel sound heard in sit, while seat contains the long vowel sound heard in see.

items.stem: A trader bought a consignment of goods for 40000 and sold the whole consignment for 50000. What was his percentage profit?
items.explanation: Profit is 50000 minus 40000 = 10000, and 10000 divided by 40000 times 100 gives 25 percent profit.

items.stem: Solve for x in the linear equation 2x + 7 = 19.
items.explanation: Subtracting 7 from both sides gives 2x = 12, and dividing by 2 gives x = 6. Substituting back gives 12 + 7 = 19.

items.stem: The quadratic equation x squared minus 5x plus 6 equals zero has its roots at
items.explanation: Factorising gives (x - 2)(x - 3) = 0, so the roots are 2 and 3, since 2 times 3 = 6 and 2 + 3 = 5.

items.stem: If x + y = 12 and x - y = 2, what is the value of x?
items.explanation: Adding the two equations gives 2x = 14, so x = 7, and then y = 5. Substituting back gives 7 + 5 = 12 and 7 - 5 = 2.

items.stem: Expand the product of the expressions (x + 2) and (x - 3).
items.explanation: Multiplying out gives x^2 - 3x + 2x - 6, which simplifies to x^2 - x - 6.

items.stem: Simplify 2 cubed multiplied by 2 squared, giving the answer as a single number.
items.explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base we add the indices, so 2^3 x 2^2 = 2^5 = 32.

items.stem: Evaluate the logarithm to base ten of one hundred.
items.explanation: Since 10^2 = 100, the logarithm to base ten of one hundred equals 2.

items.stem: Simplify the surd expression the square root of 50 plus the square root of 8.
items.explanation: Root 50 = 5 root 2 and root 8 = 2 root 2, so adding gives 5 root 2 + 2 root 2 = 7 root 2.

items.stem: The arithmetic progression 5, 9, 13 continues in the same way. What is its eighth term?
items.explanation: The first term is 5 and the common difference is 4, so the eighth term is 5 + 7 times 4 = 5 + 28 = 33.

items.stem: The geometric progression 3, 6, 12 continues in the same way. What is its fifth term?
items.explanation: The common ratio is 2, so the fifth term is 3 times 2^4 = 3 times 16 = 48.

items.stem: Differentiate the expression y = 4x cubed with respect to x.
items.explanation: The rule for powers multiplies the term by its index and reduces the index by one, so the derivative of 4x^3 is 12x^2.

items.stem: Find the indefinite integral of 6x with respect to x.
items.explanation: The integral of 6x is 3x^2 plus a constant of integration, because differentiating 3x^2 returns 6x.

items.stem: A rectangle has a length of 12 cm and a breadth of 5 cm. What is the area of the rectangle?
items.explanation: The area of a rectangle is length times breadth, so 12 times 5 = 60 square cm.

items.stem: In a right-angled triangle the side opposite a given angle is 3 and the hypotenuse is 5. What is the sine of the angle?
items.explanation: Sine equals the opposite side divided by the hypotenuse, so the sine is 3 divided by 5, which equals 0.6.

items.stem: The scores of five students in a test are 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12. What is the mean score?
items.explanation: The sum of the scores is 40 and there are five scores, so the mean is 40 divided by 5 = 8.

items.stem: The newton is the SI unit of force. Expressed in base SI units, one newton is equivalent to
items.explanation: Since force equals mass times acceleration, one newton is one kilogram metre per second squared, which are the base SI units.

items.stem: A car travelling at 20 m per s slows down uniformly and comes to rest in 5 seconds. What is its deceleration?
items.explanation: Deceleration is change in velocity divided by time, so 20 divided by 5 = 4 metres per second squared.

items.stem: A body of mass 10 kg is pushed with a force of 50 N across a frictionless horizontal surface. What is its acceleration?
items.explanation: From Newton's second law, acceleration equals force divided by mass, so 50 divided by 10 = 5 metres per second squared.

items.stem: A force of 20 N moves a box through a distance of 3 m in the direction of the force. How much work is done by the force?
items.explanation: Work equals force times distance in the direction of the force, so 20 times 3 = 60 joules.

items.stem: A force of 200 N acts on an area of 0.5 square metres. What is the pressure exerted?
items.explanation: Pressure equals force divided by area, so 200 divided by 0.5 = 400 pascals.

items.stem: The quantity of heat needed to raise the temperature of a body depends on its mass, its specific heat capacity and its
items.explanation: Heat gained equals mass times specific heat capacity times temperature change, so the third factor needed is the change in temperature.

items.stem: A wave has a frequency of 50 Hz and a wavelength of 2 m. What is the speed of the wave?
items.explanation: Wave speed equals frequency times wavelength, so 50 times 2 = 100 metres per second.

items.stem: A resistor of resistance 5 ohms carries a current of 2 A. What is the potential difference across the resistor?
items.explanation: By Ohm's law the potential difference equals current times resistance, so 2 times 5 = 10 volts.

items.stem: Two resistors of 3 ohms and 6 ohms are connected in series in a circuit. What is their effective resistance?
items.explanation: Resistors in series add directly, so the effective resistance is 3 + 6 = 9 ohms.

items.stem: When two like magnetic poles are brought close to each other, they will
items.explanation: Like magnetic poles repel one another, while unlike poles attract; so two like poles brought together repel.

items.stem: A ray of light passes from air into a glass block at an angle. As it enters the glass the ray
items.explanation: Light travels more slowly in glass than in air, so on entering the denser glass it bends towards the normal.

items.stem: A block of metal has a mass of 600 g and a volume of 200 cubic centimetres. What is the density of the metal?
items.explanation: Density equals mass divided by volume, so 600 divided by 200 = 3 grams per cubic centimetre.

items.stem: An electric bulb rated 100 W is switched on for 5 hours. How much energy in kilowatt-hours does the bulb consume?
items.explanation: Energy in kilowatt-hours equals power in kilowatts times time in hours, so 0.1 times 5 = 0.5 kilowatt-hours.

items.stem: A body of mass 4 kg moves with a velocity of 3 m per s. What is the momentum of the body?
items.explanation: Momentum equals mass times velocity, so 4 times 3 = 12 kilogram metres per second.

items.stem: The acceleration due to gravity near the surface of the earth is approximately
items.explanation: The standard value of the acceleration of free fall near the earth's surface is about 9.8 metres per second squared.

items.stem: The number of protons in the nucleus of an atom of an element is known as its
items.explanation: The atomic number of an element is defined as the number of protons in the nucleus of one of its atoms.

items.stem: Elements that belong to the same group of the periodic table have the same number of
items.explanation: A group is a vertical column of elements, and members of the same group share the same number of electrons in their outermost shell.

items.stem: The type of chemical bond formed by the complete transfer of electrons from a metal atom to a non-metal atom is called
items.explanation: Transfer of electrons from a metal to a non-metal produces oppositely charged ions held together by ionic bonding.

items.stem: How many moles are present in 44 g of carbon dioxide when its molar mass is 44 g per mole?
items.explanation: The number of moles equals mass divided by molar mass, so 44 divided by 44 = 1 mole.

items.stem: An aqueous solution with a pH value of 2 is best described as
items.explanation: A pH of 2 is well below 7, and the lower the pH the more acidic the solution, so the solution is strongly acidic.

items.stem: The reaction between an acid and a base to produce a salt and water is generally called
items.explanation: When an acid reacts with a base to give a salt and water, the reaction is called neutralisation.

items.stem: In a redox reaction, the substance that gains electrons and has its oxidation number decreased is said to be
items.explanation: Gain of electrons lowers the oxidation number, and reduction is defined as the gain of electrons.

items.stem: The general molecular formula that represents the alkane family of hydrocarbons is
items.explanation: Alkanes are saturated hydrocarbons whose general formula is CnH2n+2, as seen in methane and ethane.

items.stem: According to Boyle's law, at constant temperature the volume of a fixed mass of gas is inversely proportional to its
items.explanation: Boyle's law states that at constant temperature the volume of a fixed mass of gas is inversely proportional to its pressure.

items.stem: During the electrolysis of dilute sulphuric acid, the gas evolved at the cathode is
items.explanation: Hydrogen ions migrate to the cathode, where they gain electrons and are discharged as hydrogen gas.

items.stem: A mixture of common salt and water can best be separated in order to recover the solid salt by the process of
items.explanation: The salt is dissolved in the water, so evaporating the water leaves the solid salt behind; filtration would not separate a solution.

items.stem: The permanent hardness of water is caused mainly by the presence in the water of
items.explanation: Permanent hardness is caused by soluble calcium and magnesium sulphates, which cannot be removed by boiling.

items.stem: Which of the following metals is the most reactive with cold water?
items.explanation: Potassium reacts vigorously with cold water, while copper, silver and gold are unreactive metals low in the activity series.

items.stem: The rate of a chemical reaction generally increases when the temperature is raised because the reacting particles
options: gain more energy and collide more frequently
items.explanation: A rise in temperature gives the particles more kinetic energy, so they collide more often and with greater energy, increasing the rate.

items.stem: In the reaction 2H2 + O2 gives 2H2O, how many moles of water are produced from 3 moles of hydrogen?
items.explanation: The equation shows that 2 moles of hydrogen give 2 moles of water, so 3 moles of hydrogen give 3 moles of water.
